description:
Welcome to our Thanksgiving Marathon!Show more Join us for the VSRF Weekly Update
with Founder, Steve Kirsch & Executive Director, Louisa Clary
Every Thursday 7 PM EST / 4 PM PST
Register at https://www.VacSafety.org
On Reel 1 (this video):
Dr. Pierre Kory, MD.
Lt. Col. Dr. Pete Chambers
Died Suddenly News Founder, Tiago Henriques
On Reel 2:
Kelly Victory, MD
Ryan Cole, MD
Richard Urso, MD
On Reel 3:
Christina Parks, PhD
Richard Urso, MD
On Reel 4:
Geert Vanden Bossche, MD
Alex Berenson
Pierre Kory, MD
This Thanksgiving, the VSRF wants to say thank you to you, our supporters and viewers, who have made our research, public education and advocacy of the safety and efficacy issues with Covid-19 vaccines possible. We know it is you who have shared our work and our campaigns, creating awareness that has started the fire to eliminate all mandates and help the vaccine injured. And most importantly, your help in supporting us and spreading the word, has had an incredible impact on your families, friends, colleagues and neighbors and their personal decision to decline the Covid-19 vaccine which has saved lives. We are truly grateful.
This Marathon is just a small part of our collective work this past year. The truth will continue to come out and remember, as our founder, Steve Kirsch often says, "We will win!" Our hearts and our gratitude are with you and your family this holiday. We sincerely wish you a blessed Thanksgiving.
We are grateful for your support. You can donate to the VSRF here:
https://www.vacsafety.org/donate
